transcript.content: Hello, welcome. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

My wife wanted me to come in because I’ve been hearing things in the house. I keep hearing water running, and men whispering inside the walls, but when I check, there’s nobody there and nothing’s on. Sometimes I also see this dark wet patch spreading across the hallway, but when I go look, it’s dry. It’s been scaring her… and me too.
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you used to enjoy?
Yeah… most days I do. I wake up already feeling like I’ve failed somehow — like I’m not a good husband, not much of a man. And that feeling just kind of sits on me all day, heavy, until I go to bed.
Have there been times when you felt unusually high, overly energetic, or so good that you didn’t feel like you needed much sleep?
No… I don’t think so. I can’t remember feeling unusually high or full of energy like that. Sleep’s been a problem sometimes, but not because I felt great or didn’t need it.

Have you ever had experiences where you believed something was true that others didn’t seem to agree with — like someone was watching you, trying to harm you, or that you had special abilities others didn’t?

Yeah… I mean, I know how it sounds, but I’m pretty sure the mold and the wiring in that house have poisoned everything I own. Clothes, furniture, all of it. And I can tell the neighbors are watching me, like they’re waiting for me to mess up again.
Do you believe that the mold and wiring in your house poisoning your belongings and the neighbors watching you are definitely real, even though others might not see it that way?

Yes. I know it sounds far-fetched, but to me it’s real. I’m certain the mold and the wiring in that house have poisoned my things — my clothes, the furniture, everything. And the neighbors… I can tell they’re watching, waiting for me to mess up again.
Have you ever tried to convince others about the mold and the neighbors watching, and how did you feel when they didn’t believe you?

Yeah, I’ve tried to tell people. I’ve explained that the mold and the wiring poisoned my clothes and furniture, everything I had in that house. And I told them the neighbors are watching me, waiting for me to mess up.

When they don’t believe me, it’s frustrating… and it makes me feel alone. Like they think I’m making it up, but I’m not. To me it’s real.
Have these beliefs about the mold poisoning your belongings and the neighbors watching you been present most of the time, even when you’re not feeling particularly down or stressed?

No… not really. Before the problems with the house dragged on and before I got this low, I wasn’t hearing things in the walls or seeing wet spots that other people said weren’t there. I wasn’t thinking the neighbors were tracking me either.

That all started after I’d already kind of stopped caring about my normal life and started feeling like a failure every day.

So you mentioned that these experiences with the mold, the neighbors watching, and hearing things started after you began feeling down and like a failure. Do these strange experiences ever happen when you're not feeling depressed or low?

No. I mean, not that I can remember. Before the house problems went on so long and before I got this depressed, I wasn’t hearing voices in the walls or seeing wet patches other people said weren’t there. I didn’t think the neighbors were tracking me then.

Those things really only started after I’d already stopped caring about my normal life and felt like a failure every day.
So, when you hear the voices or see the wet spots or feel like the neighbors are watching, does that only happen when you're feeling really down or depressed?

Yes… that’s how it seems. Before the house stuff dragged on and I got so depressed, I wasn’t hearing voices in the walls or seeing wet spots other people didn’t see. I wasn’t thinking the neighbors were tracking me either.

It only really started after I’d stopped caring about my normal life and felt like a failure every day.
